name: Abed Nego
overview: Abed Nego, also called Azariah, was one of the Jewish captives taken to Babylon, as noted in Daniel 1:6-7. Along with Daniel, Hananiah, and Mishael, he was given a Babylonian name by the prince of the eunuchs, reflecting the cultural pressure to conform. Despite these challenges, the narrative highlights God's favor upon Daniel and his companions, illustrating their faithfulness and God's providential care in a foreign land.
